name: Claude-Code-Game-Studios
description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
one_liner: Turns a single Claude Code chat into a simulated game studio — dozens of specialist AI 'employees' like a designer, programmer, and QA tester that hand work to each other.
buyer: A solo indie game developer with coding skills but no design, art, or QA team, who wants Claude Code to act like a full studio around them.
business_use_cases: A solo dev uses it to get a structured game design doc, sprint plan, and QA pass instead of winging an entire project in one chat.
A game-dev content creator streams 'building a game with a 49-agent AI studio' as the hook for their channel.
A small 2-3 person studio borrows the hierarchy and rules as lightweight process scaffolding instead of hiring a producer.

money_ideas.idea: A paid, polished version with a hosted dashboard and progress tracking for small studios, instead of raw markdown files.
Genre-specific agent packs (roguelike studio, mobile puzzle studio) sold as add-ons.

steal_this: Fork it down to 5 core agents (designer, programmer, artist, QA, producer) and ship a 'mini studio' template for one specific engine — far easier to actually finish a game with.
